title: Cooked Salmon Hunger Bar (Bone Version)
description: Replaces the default hunger bar sprites with a sprites of cooked salmon!
body:
### Description:
This texture pack replaces the standard meat-themed hunger bar sprites with salmon-themed ones.
###  Features:
- Redrawn hunger bar sprites.
- Redrawn hunger effect icon.
###
A simple overhaul focused on the hunger system.
